夌: the name of the father of the Emperor Yao
焌: to singe sth with a smoldering object (e.g. burn a hole in one's trousers with a cigarette)
to pour a mixture of hot oil and flavorings over food
焌油: to pour heated oil and seasonings over food (e.g. a cooked fish)
礌石: (old) rocks that can be dropped from a height onto an attacking enemy
茌平区: Chiping, a district of Liaocheng City 聊城市[Liao2 cheng2 Shi4], Shandong
